long_name: SAI x frame configuration regist er (SAI_AFRCR)
description: SAI x frame configuration regist er specification

bit_fields.name: FRL[7
bit_fields.description: 0]: Frame length. These bits are set and cleared by software.

bit_fields.name: FSALL[6
bit_fields.description: 0]: Frame synchronization active level length. These bits are set and cleared by software

bit_fields.name: FSDEF
bit_fields.description: Frame synchronization definition. This bit is set and cleared by software.

bit_fields.name: FSPOL
bit_fields.description: Frame synchronization polarity. This bit is set and cleared by software

bit_fields.name: FSOFF
bit_fields.description: Frame synchronization offset. This bit is set and cleared by software.
